summary: Appeal against conviction for quadruple murder and house-trespass; circumstantial evidence standard: full chain, no reasonable doubt; illicit relationship motive established via prior incident; accused's presence at scene confirmed; suicide pact defense rejected as implausible; evidence chain includes auto driver testimony, blood trail, hole in wall; High Court reduced death sentence to 30 years life imprisonment without remission; appellant challenged evidentiary sufficiency and excessive sentence.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction upheld; sentence of life imprisonment for 30 years without remission confirmed.
